Name: Genrebear's Nicer Greenhouse
Author: genrebear
Description:
A greenhouse with plenty of space for crops, trees, decorations and everything else you need, without being overwhelmingly big. It's my first time making a mod and I plan to add extra configuration options and features as soon as I learn how to implement them! Feel free to giveme some feedback and suggestions~


★ Features ★

    8 spaces for iridium sprinklers (192 crops)
    16 spaces for quality sprinklers or trees (16 trees or 128 crops)
    All the floor space that doesn't have decorations can be tilled and used for more trees or crops


★ Compatibility ★

    1.6+ compatible
    It may or may not be compatible with recolors, I haven't tested to check
    Not compatible with other mods which change the greenhouse, but you canturn off the changes to the greenhouse on those mods to make them compatible


★ Future Plans ★

    Recolor compatibility
    Add the options to remove the space on the right or make it unlockable with a bundle
    [s]Add version without pre-built decorations[/s]
    Add some pretty lamps and other light sources


★ Installation ★

    Download and install the requirements
    Extract "[CP] Genrebear's Nicer Greenhouse" folder to Stardew Valley/Mods
    Run the game with SMAPI
